messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — v3 kernel canary showed a latency regression for long-seq + large KV workloads.
Maria: bench summary: model=llama2, batch=8, seq=2048, kv≈15MB
Maria: baseline (flashv2): p50 38ms p95 62ms p99 85ms
Maria: flashv3 canary: p50 41ms p95 78ms p99 101ms
Ben: ouch. any OOMs or correctness diffs?
Maria: no correctness diffs; no OOMs but GPU SM utilization spiked and L2 misses up.
Aj: can you paste the perf trace / flamegraph?
Maria: pasted flame link: https://perf.redwood/internal/flame/2275
Maria: traced hot path to softmax kernel (paged+fused path), KV refill loop shows extra memcpy calls
Zoe: is this specific to paged-attn path or general v3?
Maria: appears when KV cache size > ~10-12MB (long context, many parallel requests) — paged fallback used more often and kernel scheduling delays increase
Sahil: could be batching heuristic changes in v3 — we changed continuous-batch sizing for seq>1024 last quarter
Ben: propose immediate gating: enable flashv3 only for seq_len <= 1024 and kv_size <= 8MB; fallback to flashv2 otherwise
Aj: agree. also add a p99 latency SLA check: if p99 >= 1.25 * baseline for >5m, auto-fallback
Zoe: adding telemetry tags for kernel_variant, kv_bytes, seq_len, batch_size will help (we already have kernel_variant but need kv_bytes)
Maria: example feature flag snippet to gate:
```
feature_flags:
  flash_attn_v3:
    enabled: false
    rules:
      - condition: seq_len <= 1024 and kv_bytes <= 8_000_000
        enabled: true
      - condition: p99_ratio < 1.25
        enabled: true
```
Aj: ops-bot will run a canary with updated flags in staging. Can we get a repro script for customer-like load?
Maria: repro command:
```
python -m bench.attn --model llama2 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --kv-bytes 15000000 --kernel flashv3 --requests 2000
```
Sahil: I'll run that on p4x2 and p8x1 to compare kernels
Ben: add a Prometheus rule to alert when kernel_migrations/sec > 10 and p99 > baseline*1.2
Zoe: also track small-sample regressions: track top-5 prompt families by token length
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for flashv3-gated (flags applied) — canary group: 2 hosts, ramp 10% traffic
Maria: monitoring urls: <https://console.redwood/rt/flashv3-canary|canary dashboard>
Aj: checklist for safe rollout:
- telemetry: kv_bytes, kernel_variant, batch_size, seq_len (done)
- gating: seq_len/kv rules + p99 auto-fallback (PR open)
- repros run on 2 HW configs (in progress)
- rollback script tested (done)
Ben: timeline: extend canary 2 hours after repro passes, then 25% for 1h, then 100% if stable
Sahil: I'll post the bench logs to the perf channel once runs finish
Zoe: +1, and let's coordinate with oncall for overnight window in case of regressions
Maria: action items pinned:
- Sahil: run repros on p4/p8 and post logs (ETA 2h)
- Aj: add p99 auto-fallback rule to runtime (ETA 4h)
- Ben: add Prom alert for kernel migration spikes (ETA 3h)
- Zoe: ensure telemetry kv_bytes field shipped to metrics (ETA 1h)
- Maria: update rollout doc and gating PR (ETA 3h)
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary ramp updated to 10% -> 10% (no change)
Ben: thanks — will follow up with perf graphs
Maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
